what: MM-ROWS (2026-10-23): the k-blocked GEMM's pool tasks as many whole column blocks as leave a job sixteen tasks (every column from 2,048 rows), its serial nest a chunk of 128 rows at a time where A's panel is 2 MiB or more and a chunk's slice at most 512 KiB, an AVX-512 edge block computing the vectors its columns reach, and a pair or group job starting with the part whose tasks are the larger -- every value as it was. Measured on the committed tree against the tree before it: the cross-build hashes, the GEMMs with both units in one process beside an A/A control, the decoder's training step (the v1 contract a control), the GEO step a part at a time, and the GEO study's attention model's training update and inference forward built as the study builds them, against PyTorch; and the design runs.
host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.30GHz, 4 vCPU (AVX-512F, AVX512-BF16 and -FP16, AMX), 2 MiB of L2 a core, 260 MiB of L3 -- the host the session moved to on 2026-10-23; Linux 6.18; clang 18.1.3, gcc 13.3.0; Python 3.11.15, torch 2.13.0+cu130 (CPU), numpy 2.2.6; OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE
